title_zh: 比较色号后选择带走色卡而不购买

scenario.label_zh: 比较化妆品色号并选择带走色卡
scenario.goal_zh: 说明对两种色号的犹豫，比较后选择带走色卡而暂不购买

context_zh: 美国化妆品店顾客艾琳与店员娜奥米比较口红色号。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Erin
sentences.text: I'm replacing some of my makeup, but I have mixed feelings about this bright lipstick.

sentences.speaker: Naomi
sentences.text: What do you like about it, and what worries you?

sentences.speaker: Erin
sentences.text: I like the color in the tube. On this sample card, though, it looks much stronger.

sentences.speaker: Naomi
sentences.text: Here's the softer shade beside it. The difference is minor in this light, so it may help to compare the cards near the window.

sentences.speaker: Erin
sentences.text: I can see the difference there, but I'm still not ready to choose.

sentences.speaker: Naomi
sentences.text: You can take these printed shade cards home. There's no need to buy today.

sentences.speaker: Erin
sentences.text: I'll do that, thanks. I'd rather look at them beside the clothes I actually wear.

targets.sense_zh: 相互矛盾的；褒贬不一的
